data.one_liner: Windows implementation of the camera plugin for getting info and controlling cameras
data.what_it_does: Provides the Windows platform-specific implementation for the Flutter camera plugin. It allows developers to control cameras, capture images, and record video on Windows applications by depending alongside the main camera package.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting Windows that needs camera access.
You want to capture photos or record videos within a Windows desktop app.
avoid_when: You need advanced features like focus mode, flash mode, exposure controls, or streaming of frames which are currently unsupported on Windows.
You are developing for non-Windows platforms.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the main camera plugin ecosystem.
Supports custom video output path and video settings like FPS and bitrate.
weaknesses: Many features are missing or limited on Windows, such as flash mode, focus modes, device orientation, and frame streaming due to Windows API limitations.
Not an endorsed federated plugin, so it must be explicitly added to pubspec.yaml.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding both the camera package and camera_windows explicitly to pubspec.yaml, and ensuring correct path resolution for saving files.
